scenarios.title: Mara at East Gate
scenarios.text:
Mara tends a lantern at East Gate.

East Gate closes at sunset.

scenarios.title: Two Irises
scenarios.text:
Iris is the lighthouse keeper.

Iris keeps the lamp trimmed through storms.

Iris marks shoals on the chart.

Another Iris is the ferry pilot.

The brass gate opens when Mara lifts the lantern.

The lantern is kept at East Gate.

scenarios.title: Village Ferry Boundary
scenarios.text:
Merehaven is a village on the river.

The ferry leaves from the old quay at dawn.
